title.zh: 精确中平面压力磁通状态

summary: Sample radial pressure along the exact Z=0 row, fit pressure against the increasing flux prefix through the first zero-pressure sample, and return a clipped pressure derivative and structured spline state.

identity.relation: midplane pressure P(R) and flux psi(R,Z) to pressure-flux spline and dP/dpsi
identity.direction: R-Z grid, psi and P(R) -> pressure-of-psi representation, flattened derivative and zero-current state
identity.definition: Sort only the unique exact Z=0 midplane indices by physical radius, rejecting duplicate radii. Sample nonnegative finite P(R); fit the strictly increasing flux prefix of at least four points through the first outward exact zero-pressure edge. Serialize that exact prefix, knots, coefficients and cubic degree. Evaluate dP/dpsi in original C-order grid layout, reject nonfinite coefficients or derivatives before clipping, then zero values above psi_edge or at true boolean plasma_mask cells. Return the finite derivative and aligned zero-current vector.
identity.model: Axisymmetric isotropic cubic pressure-flux construction with physical radial traversal and exactly reconstructible fit
identity.geometry: two-dimensional cylindrical R-Z sample arrays with one complete exact Z=0 row
identity.coordinates: cylindrical R and Z in metres; arrays indexed [Z,R], output derivative and current vectors flattened in C order
identity.boundary: The first exact zero P(R) sample is the limiter and sets psi_edge; derivative is zero for psi > psi_edge and at true plasma_mask entries. The spline is constructed with ext='zeros'.
assumptions: The supplied pressure profile is a nonnegative scalar function of cylindrical radius and defines an exact zero-pressure boundary.
Physical midplane radii are distinct; psi rises strictly along increasing physical radius through the first zero-pressure sample, independently of storage order.
For the maintained isotropic Picard chain the caller supplies psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad; the spline alone does not independently establish physical equilibrium or enforce a flux normalization.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius grid used to sample pressure on the exact midplane row.
inputs.constraints: Finite 2-D values matching z_grid and psi; midplane radii must be distinct. Only midplane traversal is sorted by radius; output layout is preserved.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial coordinate grid identifying the unique exact-zero midplane row.
inputs.constraints: Finite and same shape as r_grid; exactly one complete row must equal 0.0, and exactly N_R cells in total may equal 0.0.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Axisymmetric psi=R A_phi at each R-Z grid point in the maintained chain.
inputs.constraints: Finite and same shape as r_grid; values on the midplane prefix through the first zero-pressure sample must be strictly increasing, with at least four samples.

inputs.name: pressure_of_radius
inputs.description: Callable returning scalar pressure for each exact-midplane radius.
inputs.units: R input m; pressure output Pa
inputs.dtype: callable returning real scalar values convertible to float64
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative scalar at every midplane radius, called in increasing physical-radius order; an exact zero defines the boundary.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Optional mask whose true entries set the corresponding flattened pressure derivative to zero.
inputs.constraints: Must be genuinely boolean and shape-matched; numeric truth-value coercion is not accepted.

outputs.name: pressure_derivative
outputs.description: Finite spline derivative in C order after edge and boolean-mask clipping.
outputs.constraints: Nonfinite values fail before any clipping. Zero for psi > psi_edge and true mask entries.

outputs.name: zero_currents
outputs.description: All-zero initial current vector aligned with pressure_derivative.
outputs.constraints: C-order flattened all-zero array; no current is solved by this operator.

outputs.name: psi_edge
outputs.description: Flux at the first exact-zero-pressure midplane sample.
outputs.constraints: Taken from the same midplane position as limiter_index.

outputs.name: pressure_of_psi
outputs.description: Structured representation of the fitted pressure-versus-flux spline.
outputs.units: psi fields Wb/rad; pressure fields Pa; degree and descriptors dimensionless
outputs.dtype: mapping of float64 arrays, integer degree and string descriptors
outputs.constraints: psi_samples and pressure_samples contain exactly the fitted prefix through limiter_index; knots, coefficients, degree and extrapolation=zeros describe the same cubic spline.

outputs.name: limiter_index
outputs.description: First exact-zero pressure index in increasing physical-radius order.
outputs.constraints: Zero-based position in the physically sorted midplane, not a whole-grid or storage-order index.

preconditions: A unique complete exact-zero Z row and a pressure profile with an exact zero boundary are available.
The first-zero prefix of midplane psi is strictly increasing and has at least four samples.
supported: Cubic pressure-flux interpolation and finite clipped derivative in caller grid order, including descending radial storage and an interior zero-pressure boundary.
excluded: General inference of the magnetic axis, limiter or flux-surface geometry.
Anisotropic pressure closure or a pressure-current equilibrium solve.
Pressure profiles without an exact zero sample or flux prefixes that are not strictly increasing.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-2D, nonfinite or shape-mismatched grids; a missing or nonunique complete exact-zero row; noncallable pressure; nonfinite or negative pressure samples; no exact-zero pressure boundary; an insufficient or non-increasing midplane flux prefix; or wrong-shaped plasma_mask. Duplicate midplane radii and nonboolean masks also raise ValueError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite fitted coefficients or derivative; callback/SciPy failures propagate. Clipping cannot hide invalid numerical states.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this spline construction does not iterate toward equilibrium.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result mapping is returned if validation or spline construction raises.

example.description: Fit a linearly decreasing midplane pressure profile and mask one derivative cell.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium.pressure_flux_state import build_pressure_flux_state
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, 4), [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1])
mask = np.zeros_like(r_grid, dtype=bool)
mask[1, 2] = True
result = build_pressure_flux_state(r_grid, z_grid, r_grid.copy(), lambda radius: max(0.8 - radius, 0.0), plasma_mask=mask)
expected = np.full(r_grid.size, -1.0)
expected[6] = 0.0
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['pressure_derivative'], expected)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['zero_currents'], 0.0)
assert result['limiter_index'] == 3
assert result['psi_edge'] == 0.8
assert result['pressure_of_psi']['extrapolation'] == 'zeros'
example.expected: The unmasked flattened dP/dpsi values are -1 Pa/(Wb/rad), the selected cell and current vector are zero, and the first zero-pressure boundary has psi_edge=0.8 Wb/rad.

scope: Exact-midplane pressure-spline construction and clipped derivative on a finite grid.
Mask clipping, first-zero limiter index and zero-current vector.
Selected invalid midplane and missing-zero-pressure boundary cases.
An interior edge serializes exactly four fit points and independently reconstructs pressure and derivative.
Descending radial storage preserves physical edge and original output order; numeric masks and nonfinite fit/derivative fail.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Targeted source regressions, explicit analytic fixtures and a selected no-source installed-wheel replay cover this finite contract. No arbitrary physical-model suitability, continuum convergence, human scientific endorsement or redistribution permission is inferred.
known_limitations: Strict exact-zero tests for both midplane and pressure boundary do not tolerate near-zero samples.
The prefix and spline are identical representations of the chosen interpolant; this does not prove the prescribed pressure law or extrapolation physically suitable.
Grid rectilinearity and pressure-profile physics are not validated; public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
